text:
Hello team,

Use this note to tighten daily handling across Aurelia Skyways. Boarding closes after 68 hours, so every file must be cleared before that point. Do not let a late handoff sit in the queue, and do not wait for a second reminder before moving the case forward.

For check-in, the required form is FM-286, and no packet is complete without it. Review each submission for the correct signatures, matching pet details, and a clean scan before you pass it on. If a traveler arrives with missing paperwork, stop the process and correct the gap right away.

For transfer, the Records Curator is the role in charge of the review trail, so send every update there without delay. Record each change in the desk ledger in plain language, keep the notes brief, and flag any mismatch immediately. This is a service desk, not a holding area, so follow the chain exactly and keep the workflow moving.

Training Editor Companion Animal Travel Desk
